# 🪺 Enigmatic Nest（Mysterious Bird Nest）— Mod Description

> **Author**: MoYu ｜ **Version**: 1.0.0 ｜ **Requires**: Stardew Valley 1.6 + SMAPI 4.0+

---

## 🌟 Overview

Mysterious nests appear in the wild trees of the valley—never on fruit trees. Hop onto the canopy, dig into the nest, and you might find prismatic eggs, ancient treasures… or just plain junk. Every nest is a gamble, but some nests gamble better than others: the higher the nest tier, the rarer the prizes hidden inside.

## 🎮 How to Play

### 1. Finding Nests

- Every day, each **mature wild tree** without a nest has a chance to grow one (default 35%, configurable);
- There are **6 nest tiers**: Plain → Silver → Gold → Diamond → Iridium → Prismatic (Prismatic nests are a 0.1% rarity);
- Stand beside a tree and press the **Jump Key** (default **Space**, configurable) to leap onto the canopy—the foliage fades to reveal the nest. Press the jump key or **S** to hop down.

### 2. Grabbing Rewards (Egg Capsule Opening)

- While on the canopy, **right-click** the nest to open the reward menu: the nest holds a batch of **egg capsules** (Plain nests: 5 eggs; +2 eggs per higher nest tier);
- Each capsule's **tier** follows a probability ladder based on nest quality (Plain nests: mostly plain eggs, prismatic eggs at just 0.1%; Prismatic nests: up to 10% prismatic);
- Opening animation: the capsule **wobbles** first, then cracks—the higher the tier, the longer the crack (0.75s base, +0.25s per tier);
- **20% of capsules never crack**—that's an intact bird egg (6 kinds: Plain → Prismatic); the other **80% crack open** to reveal random loot:
  - Trash, big craftables, forage, minerals, seeds, artifacts… or **treasures**;
  - Treasure odds rise with egg tier (Plain egg 1% → Prismatic egg 11%);
- **Click an item to collect it into your backpack** (unclaimed items are lost when closing the menu); your real inventory is shown below for sorting.

### 3. Collecting & The Display Stand

- 14 treasures total (from the Sea-Blue Pendant to the Peach Blossom)—all **artifact class**, museum-donatable;
- Craft and place the **Display Stand**, then right-click with an item to **display it on the stand** (one item at a time);
- **Stand Bonus**: every **unique** treasure on display adds **+1% to your selling prices** (duplicate treasures on multiple stands only count once);
- Hidden easter egg: display the **Peach Blossom** on a stand and petals will trail behind you as you walk (toggle in config).

### 4. Item Catalogue

- **Bird Eggs (6)**: Plain / Silver / Gold / Diamond / Iridium / Prismatic (animal goods)
- **Trash (5)**: Glass Bottle / Moldy Bread / Broken Shoe / Waste Paper / Bird Feather (trash class)
- **Treasures (14)**: Sea-Blue Pendant, Magic Feather, Crystal Skull, Heart of the Earth, Heart of Stardew, Starry Tear, Dream Amber, Ruby Medal, Golden Cup, Big Gold Coin, Galaxy Rose, Night Epiphyllum, Love Gem, Peach Blossom (artifact class)

## ⚙️ Configuration (GMCM visual menu)

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| Jump Key | Key to jump onto / off the canopy (default Space) |
| Canopy Transparency | Fade amount of the foliage while on the tree |
| Nest Spawn Chance | Daily chance for a nest to appear on a wild tree |
| Nest Horizontal / Vertical Offset | Position of the nest sprite on the canopy |
| Nest Size | Scale of the nest sprite |
| Nests on Special Trees | Allow nests on mystic / mushroom / palm etc. |
| Petals While Walking | Toggle the Peach Blossom petal trail |
| Debug Logging | Verbose console logs |

> Numeric data (item prices, nest odds, loot tables) can be edited directly in `assets/items.json` inside the mod folder.

## 📦 Installation

1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/) (4.0+) and Stardew Valley 1.6;
2. Drop this mod folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods/`;
3. Launch the game via SMAPI and enjoy.

## ❤️ Credits

Thanks for playing! Gambling has risks—make sure to leave room in your backpack before opening eggs.

# 🪺 神秘鸟窝 Enigmatic Nest（模组介绍）

> **作者**：MoYu ｜ **版本**：1.0.0 ｜ **适用**：星露谷物语 1.6 + SMAPI 4.0+

---

## 🌟 简介

林间的野树上，藏着神秘鸟窝——它们只在野生的树上出现，果树可找不到它们。跳上树冠，掏开鸟窝，你可能会收获五彩的鸟蛋、远古的宝藏、又或者……只是一堆垃圾。鸟窝的收获全凭运气，但运气也分高低：品级越高的鸟窝，藏着的宝贝越珍贵。

## 🎮 玩法介绍

### 1. 寻找鸟窝

- 每天，没有鸟窝的**成熟野树**都有概率长出一个鸟窝（默认概率 35%，可在配置中调整）；
- 鸟窝共 **6 个品级**：普通 → 银 → 金 → 钻石 → 铱 → 五彩（品级越高越稀有，五彩鸟窝仅有 0.1% 概率）；
- 走到野树旁按下跳跃键（默认**空格**，可配置），玩家会**跳上树冠**，树冠随之虚化露出鸟窝；再按跳跃键或 **S** 键跳下。

### 2. 摸宝（扭蛋开箱）

- 在树冠上对鸟窝**右键**，打开摸宝界面：鸟窝里是若干颗**扭蛋**（普通鸟窝 5 颗，每提升一档品质 +2 颗）；
- 每颗蛋的**品级**按鸟窝品质的概率阶梯生成（普通鸟窝里：普通蛋最多，五彩蛋仅 0.1%；五彩鸟窝里五彩蛋可达 10%）；
- 扭蛋开箱动画：蛋会先**摇晃**，品级越高裂开越久（0.75 秒起，每档 +0.25 秒）；
- **20% 的蛋不会碎**——那就是一颗完整的鸟蛋（普通→五彩鸟蛋共 6 种）；其余 **80% 会碎开**，随机爆出：
  - 垃圾、大型工艺品、采集物、矿物、种子、古物……或**宝藏**；
  - 宝藏掉率随蛋品级提升（普通蛋 1% → 五彩蛋 11%）；
- 点击物品即可**收录进背包**（未领取的物品关闭界面时作废），下方就是你的背包，可随时整理。

### 3. 收藏与展台

- 摸到的宝藏共 14 件（从海蓝吊坠到万里桃花），全部是**古物类**，可捐赠博物馆；
- 合成并摆出**展台**，右键即可把物品**放上台展示**（一次一件）；
- **展台加成**：场上每展示一件**不同的**宝藏，你出售物品的总价 +1%（相同宝藏只算一件）；
- 特殊彩蛋：展台上摆出**万里桃花**，玩家行走时身后会飘落桃花花瓣（可在配置中开关）。

### 4. 物品一览

- **鸟蛋 6 种**：普通 / 银 / 金 / 钻石 / 铱 / 五彩鸟蛋（动物产品类）
- **垃圾 5 种**：玻璃瓶 / 发霉面包 / 破鞋 / 废弃纸团 / 鸟毛（垃圾类）
- **宝藏 14 件**：海蓝吊坠、魔法羽毛、水晶骷髅头、大地之心、星露谷之心、星空之泪、梦幻琥珀、红宝石勋章、金杯、大金币、银河玫瑰、夜里昙花、爱之宝石、万里桃花（古物类）

## ⚙️ 配置（GMCM 可视化调节）

| 配置项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 跳跃键 | 跳上/跳下树冠的按键（默认空格） |
| 树冠透明度 | 树上时树冠的虚化程度 |
| 鸟窝生成概率 | 每天无窝野树长出鸟窝的概率 |
| 鸟窝水平/垂直偏移 | 鸟窝贴图在树冠上的显示位置 |
| 鸟窝大小 | 鸟窝贴图缩放 |
| 特殊树生成鸟窝 | 是否允许神秘树/蘑菇树等特殊树长鸟窝 |
| 行走花瓣特效 | 万里桃花展品的花瓣掉落开关 |
| 调试日志 | 输出详细日志 |

> 数值类数据（物品价格、鸟窝概率、掉落表）都可以直接编辑模组目录下的 `assets/items.json`。

## 📦 安装

1. 安装 [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)（4.0+）与星露谷物语 1.6；
2. 将本模组文件夹放入 `Stardew Valley/Mods/`；
3. 启动游戏（带 SMAPI）即可。

## ❤️ 致谢

感谢游玩！摸宝有风险，开蛋需谨慎（记得留背包位置）。
